test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ACDB is related to ZXWY in a certain way. In the same way, EGHF is related to VTSU. To which of the following is IKLJ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5166d0efbc95d72e42cd18f620c57b7c31ff968580d3b249da0825410fd93733.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter is replaced by its **opposite letter in the alphabet series.**

ACDB is related to ZXWY:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f095845d8e0a3467965ac5b318ef9f383e514e3edb83ea36339ac5e208561b08.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ec591a3777b1377257631316ba07e853862204f9ea490ba73b07b7b8a03b438.png] 

EGHF is related to VTSU:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/036e389bb9127854aae98fdb96ea702be918dfdbd029cf1253394d63980efc67.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe5e6d4d24dd8092d0ce6c8e404e4e2fb9969079a153ee1b15ea9e6fac882115.png] 

**Following the same logic, IKLJ will be related to:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a2f55616df1574b4cfc0bdee6bb3d101a6200386f7412264222dbc42f4bb7f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feff0a4ee933703a7c85e33acf9accb6112b6bf9c05948f6190ba41c9c6f43e.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is __Option (4)__.**
